question.worked_solution:
Since the logarithms on both sides of the equation have the same base, we can equate the arguments. This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{log}_{8}⁡({x}^{2}+19x) & ={log}_{8}⁡(10x-8) \\ {x}^{2}+19x & =10x-8 \\ {x}^{2}+9x+8 & =0 \\ (x+1)(x+8) & =0 \\ x & =-1,-8.\end{aligned}
$$

Let's now check for extraneous solutions by substituting back into the original equation: 

- Substituting $x=-1$ back into the original equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{log}_{8}⁡({x}^{2}+19x) & \overset{?}{=}{log}_{8}⁡(10x-8) \\ {log}_{8}⁡((-1)^{2}+19(-1)) & \overset{?}{=}{log}_{8}⁡(10(-1)-8) \\ {log}_{8}⁡(-18) & \overset{?}{=}{log}_{8}⁡(-18)\,\times \end{aligned}
$$

which is not valid because ${log}_{8}⁡(-18)$ is undefined. Therefore, $x=-1$ is not a valid solution.

- Substituting $x=-8$ back into the original equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{log}_{8}⁡({x}^{2}+19x) & \overset{?}{=}{log}_{8}⁡(10x-8) \\ {log}_{8}⁡((-8)^{2}+19(-8)) & \overset{?}{=}{log}_{8}⁡(10(-8)-8) \\ {log}_{8}⁡(-88) & \overset{?}{=}{log}_{8}⁡(-88)\,\times \end{aligned}
$$

which is not valid because ${log}_{8}⁡(-88)$ is undefined. Therefore, $x=-8$ is not a valid solution.

Therefore, the correct answer is "No solutions."
